title: Carly Pearce, Jennifer Nettles and Carter Faith featured on soundtrack to Netflix's upcoming 'Heartland'
line: Carly Pearce, Jennifer Nettles and Carter Faith are on the soundtrack to Netflix's upcoming Heartland. Country is headed to streaming.

title: Ty Myers, the country singer/songwriter, announced as 1st headliner for Musikfest 2027 in Bethlehem, Pa.
line: Ty Myers is the first headliner announced for Musikfest 2027 in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. Early bird gets the stage.

title: Country music legend Shania Twain to kick off major 2027 UK tour in North Yorkshire
line: Shania Twain will kick off her 2027 UK tour in North Yorkshire. She's bringing the man, and the feelings, overseas.

title: Video of two brothers Irish step dancing to Beyoncé's country hit 'Texas Hold 'Em' is pure delight
line: Two brothers Irish step danced to Beyonce's country hit "Texas Hold 'Em" in a video that's pure delight. Country with a jig.

title: “It’s A Very Special Song To Both Of Us” — Miranda Lambert Calls Writing “Over You” With Ex-Husband Blake Shelton Magical
line: Miranda Lambert says writing "Over You" with ex-husband Blake Shelton was magical, calling it a very special song to both of them. Some songs outlast everything.

title: Morgan Wallen's 2027 Sand in My Boots Festival Lineup Revealed
line: Morgan Wallen, Ella Langley and Kings of Leon will headline the 2027 Sand in My Boots Festival in Gulf Shores, Alabama, in May. Pack the sunscreen and the boots.

title: Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” Extends Her Record Again, Spending Its 26th Week At #1
line: Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" spent its 26th week at No. 1, extending her own record. That song has a lease on the top.

title: Zach Top Wraps ‘Cold Beer & Country Music Tour’ With Sold-Out Bridgestone Arena Finale
line: Zach Top wrapped his Cold Beer & Country Music Tour with a sold-out show at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville. Nothing cold about that finale.

title: Ella Langley + Her Band Went as 'Toy Story' For Halloween!
line: Ella Langley and her band went as Toy Story characters for Halloween after the band and crew voted on a group costume. To infinity and beyond the stage.

title: Ella Langley Reacts to Halloween Candy Being Thrown Onstage
line: Ella Langley loves Halloween, but she told fans to stop throwing candy onstage because it was a tripping hazard. Even stars watch their step.

title: Lainey Wilson’s Husband, Devlin ‘Duck’ Hodges, Says His Friends Keep Asking Him to Set Them Up With Ella Langley
line: Lainey Wilson's husband, Devlin "Duck" Hodges, says his friends keep asking him to set them up with Ella Langley. Good luck, fellas.

title: Riley Green Shares His Dream of Becoming a Grand Ole Opry Member
line: Riley Green says his big dream is still to become a Grand Ole Opry member. The Opry should keep a seat warm.

title: Hear HARDY and Blake Shelton’s Carefree New Duet ‘Hell’
line: HARDY and Blake Shelton released a carefree new duet called "Hell." Hot new duet, no pun intended.

title: Zach Bryan’s New Song Is a Cover By an Obscure Kentucky Songwriter
line: Zach Bryan covered "Kentucky Hurricane" by Kentucky songwriter Ian Noe and uploaded the video to YouTube. Nice way to share the spotlight.

title: Ashley Cooke to release first-ever Christmas EP ‘WRAPPED’
line: Ashley Cooke is releasing her first-ever Christmas EP, called WRAPPED. Early gift for country fans.

title: Parker McCollum On Teaching His Son Manners And Respect
line: Parker McCollum says he's raising his son to be respectful above all else, even if brains don't run in the family. Manners first, math later.

title: Ella Langley Reacts to Halloween Candy Being Thrown Onstage
line: Ella Langley loves Halloween, but drew the line at fans throwing candy onstage because it's a tripping hazard. Safety first, sugar second.

title: Morgan Wallen’s Sand In My Boots Festival Announces 2027 Dates, Promises an ‘Even Better’ Experience
line: Morgan Wallen announced 2027 dates for his Sand In My Boots Festival and says he plans to make it even better. Hard to top, but he's trying.

title: Lauren Alaina Brings 'Stages,' "All My Exes" And "Road Less Traveled" To Final Tour Stops, Including Nashville's Ryman Auditorium
line: Lauren Alaina is playing "Stages," "All My Exes" and "Road Less Traveled" on the final stops of her tour, including Nashville's Ryman Auditorium. The Ryman gets the grand finale.

title: Parker McCollum Says He Wanted to Quit Country Music Right When His Career Was Taking Off
line: Parker McCollum says he wanted to quit country music right as his career was taking off, amid burnout. Good thing he stuck around.

title: Nick Jonas, Reba McEntire, Tim McGraw and more to perform at 'Disney Celebrates America: Nashville's Star-Spangled Bash'
source: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
line: Nick Jonas, Reba McEntire, Tim McGraw and more will perform at "Disney Celebrates America: Nashville's Star-Spangled Bash." Mickey's going country.

title: Randy Travis Brings "Forever and Ever, Amen" And "Three Wooden Crosses" To Final 'More Life' Tour Shows
line: Randy Travis is playing "Forever and Ever, Amen" and "Three Wooden Crosses" at the final shows of his "More Life" tour. Forever and ever, in concert.

title: Garth Brooks gives Double Live its first vinyl release on 6 November
line: Garth Brooks' Double Live gets its first vinyl release on Nov. 6. Time to dust off the turntable.

title: One of the Greatest Men in Country Music, the Grand Ole Opry’s Longest-Serving Member; “Whisperin’ Bill Turns 89
line: Whisperin' Bill, the Grand Ole Opry's longest-serving member, turns 89. That's a whole lot of Opry nights.

title: Ella Langley closes Dandelion Tour in Saint Paul on 31 October
line: Ella Langley closes her Dandelion Tour in Saint Paul on Oct. 31. What a way to end a tour.

title: Luke Bryan Cut Zach John King From 'Idol' — Now They're Touring
line: Luke Bryan cut Zach King from 'American Idol,' and years later King is touring with him. Turns out the cut was just the opening act.

title: Jon Pardi, Zach Top, Thomas Rhett, Hudson Westbrook And More To Perform At 2027 Country Thunder Wisconsin Festival
line: Jon Pardi, Zach Top, Thomas Rhett and Hudson Westbrook will perform at the 2027 Country Thunder Wisconsin Festival. Wisconsin is about to get twangy.

title: Under The Big Sky Fest Reveals 2027 Lineup
line: The Under The Big Sky Fest revealed its 2027 lineup, led by Zach Bryan and Kacey Musgraves. Start saving now.

title: Country star Pat Green to release live album recorded in iconic Texas hall
line: Country star Pat Green will release a live album recorded in an iconic Texas hall. Boots and bleachers, all in one record.

title: Jess Moskaluke to make Opry debut as part of CCMA’s 50th birthday celebration
line: Canadian singer Jess Moskaluke will make her Grand Ole Opry debut as part of the Canadian Country Music Association's 50th birthday celebration. Canada's sending its best to Nashville.
